content: Hi, how can i assist you today?
Video game NPCs say my name without me typing it. It feels personal.
NPC dialogue often includes common names and localization strings. Which title and scene, and is your name a common one in that language pack?
It’s a common name; scene was a city market.
Market ‘barks’ usually cycle through a set list. A capture of the scene over multiple runs can show whether the same line appears at fixed intervals.
Replayed once; heard it again later.
If it repeats at similar timestamps across runs, that points to scripted audio rather than targeted addressing.
A short clip with timestamps is typically enough to compare occurrences.
